flags.why: Bù means adding enough to make up a shortfall, not straightening or levelling something, as shown in the [dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%C3%B9).
flags.fix: Remove sense 2 and place its example under sense 1.

flags.why: Cầm đầu implies leading people in wrongdoing, so using it for an ordinary leader can insult them ([dictionary definition](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/c%E1%BA%A7m_%C4%91%E1%BA%A7u)).
The common colloquial noun meaning skill level or ability is missing ([dictionary definition](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tr%C3%ACnh)).
flags.fix: noun [colloquial] | skill level; ability. ex: Trình của anh ấy cao hơn tôi. = His skill level is higher than mine.
